stem.text: What effect does decreasing carbon dioxide concentration have on haemoglobin?

A.text: It is less efficient at taking up oxygen and less efficient at releasing oxygen.

B.text: It is less efficient at taking up oxygen and more efficient at releasing oxygen.

C.text: It is more efficient at taking up oxygen and less efficient at releasing oxygen.

D.text: It is more efficient at taking up oxygen and more efficient at releasing oxygen.
